variants.prompt: the wind-up pose before it spits a storm of paper: the book-body swells up bigger and leans BACK a little, the two covers (jaws) are opened very wide as if inhaling hard, the page-teeth bristle outward, the paper legs are braced wide apart. Same red eye.
the attack pose: it LUNGES forward to the right, the whole book-body tilted forward and down toward the right, the jaws snapping half-shut at the front, the paper legs stretched back behind it.

its second, enraged form: the leather covers are torn and peeled back at the edges, many loose pages curl up and flare out around the body like a ragged mane (still attached to the body, not floating), more and longer ragged page-teeth, the single red eye bigger and bloodshot. Same size, same pose, same position.
